description: On the tabletop in front of you, there are several thin red strings lying in a loose Y-shape. The left hand settles near the center junction while the right hand pinches one strand and repeatedly crosses and pulls it over the others toward the middle, tightening and then repositioning so the strands alternate sides, gradually forming and then loosening a small braid along the upright section; the necklace string is a two-hand object during the tightening moments and shifts to a right-hand object as the left hand just steadies near the junction.
